story_fr: CrowdStrike se positionne en infrastructure de securite pour l'IA, ses resultats record du T1 traduisant un point d'inflexion porte par l'adoption de la plateforme Falcon par les clients existants et de nouveaux comptes.
story_en: CrowdStrike positions itself as AI security infrastructure, with record Q1 results marking an AI inflection point driven by platform adoption from existing customers and new logo lands.
quote: In Q1, the worlds of cybersecurity and frontier AI collided: this was the Mythos moment. CrowdStrike is AI security infrastructure, critical to successful AI adoption.

story_fr: Lancement de Project QuiltWorks, premiere coalition cyber du secteur reunissant OpenAI et Anthropic pour remedier au risque lie a l'IA de frontiere via la plateforme Falcon.
story_en: Launch of Project QuiltWorks, an industry-first cybersecurity coalition featuring OpenAI and Anthropic to remediate frontier AI risk via the Falcon platform.
quote: Announced the launch and expansion of Project QuiltWorks, an industry-first cybersecurity coalition featuring OpenAI and Anthropic to remediate frontier AI risk via the Falcon platform.

story_fr: Premiere societe pure-play de cybersecurite a depasser 5 milliards de dollars d'ARR final, avec un premier exercice au-dela du milliard de nouvel ARR net et un objectif affiche de 20 milliards d'ARR en FY36.
story_en: First pure-play cybersecurity software company to surpass $5 billion ending ARR, with its first year exceeding $1 billion of net new ARR and a stated goal of $20 billion ending ARR in FY36.
quote: We achieved $5.25 billion in ending ARR - the fastest and only pure-play cybersecurity software company to achieve this milestone - driven by a record $1.01 billion of net new ARR, our first year exceeding $1 billion of net new ARR.

story_fr: L'ARR final issu des comptes Falcon Flex atteint 1,69 milliard de dollars, en hausse de plus de 120% sur un an, confirmant le modele de consommation comme moteur de consolidation cyber.
story_en: Ending ARR from Falcon Flex accounts reaches $1.69 billion, up over 120% year-over-year, confirming the consumption model as a cybersecurity consolidation driver.
quote: Reaches $1.69 billion in ending ARR from Falcon Flex accounts, up over 120% year-over-year.

story_fr: Une etude Forrester Total Economic Impact montre que les clients remplacant une securite endpoint historique par CrowdStrike obtiennent un retour sur investissement de 273%.
story_en: A Forrester Total Economic Impact study shows customers replacing legacy endpoint security with CrowdStrike achieved a 273% return on investment.
quote: showing that customers who replaced legacy endpoint security with CrowdStrike achieved a 273% return on investment (ROI) by reducing breach risk and simplifying security operations.
